raw_blocks: Spectroscopy & Scientific Analysis Systems
Faster. Future-Ready. More Cyber Secure.
Automated nuclide identification and quantification when and where you need it.
Evolve your spectroscopy operations and drive more accurate results.
Continuous or Triggered Spectroscopic Monitoring Platform
Research, Education and Industrial Solutions (28)

Genie Spectroscopy Software Suite streamlines complex gamma and alpha spectrometry workflows with an intuitive, all-in-one platform for data acquisition, analysis, and reporting—empowering labs to achieve greater efficiency, accuracy, and collaboration. Its scalable, secure architecture supports high-throughput operations and centralized data management for confident, outcome-focused research.
BEGe™ Broad Energy Germanium Detectors
The Mirion BEGe Broad Energy Germanium Detector covers the energy range of 3 keV to 3 MeV like no other.
SEGe™ Standard Electrode Coaxial Ge Detectors
The conventional coaxial germanium detector is often referred to as Pure Ge, HPGe, Intrinsic Ge, or Hyperpure Ge.
Cryo-Pulse ® 5 Plus Electrically Refrigerated Cryostat
The Cryo-Pulse 5 Plus cryostat is an electrically powered cryostat for use with HPGe radiation detectors.
The Mirion Intelligent Cryo-Cycle Cryostat is the latest enhancement of the “hybrid” cryostat combining the advantages of electric cooling with the reliability of liquid nitrogen.
Remotely controlled via a wired or wireless connection, the Aegis Portable HPGe Spectrometer allows high resolution spectroscopy measurements to be made from a safe, comfortable location.
Series 6LB™ Automatic Low Background Alpha/Beta Counting System
The Series 6LB is an innovative, “system on slide” gas-flow sample changer with a 5.7 cm (2.25 in.) detector.
LB4200™ Multi-Detector Low Background Alpha/Beta Counting System

The LB4200 counter is the advanced alpha/beta counting system designed to simplify lab operations. The LB4200 system is perfect for applications requiring high sample throughput with long counting times, or where a number of samples must be counted at the same time. The system can be configured from one to four counting drawers. The maximum detector capacity is sixteen 5.7 cm or 3.1 cm detectors, or four 12.7 cm detectors.
PIPS ® Detectors Passivated Implanted Planar Silicon Detectors
The Passivated Implanted Planar Silicon (PIPS ® ) Detector is a product of modern semiconductor technology.
Lynx ® II Digital Signal Analyzer

The Lynx II Digital Signal Analyzer is a compact, high-performance, advanced gamma spectroscopy instrument that uses digital signal processing to deliver precise, stable measurements and supports a broad range of detector technologies. Suitable for laboratory and industrial environments, Lynx II provides reliable operation, flexible integration, and robust data security for demanding spectroscopy applications.
Alpha Analyst™ Integrated Alpha Spectrometer
The Alpha Analyst system along with Apex-Alpha™ software is the complete solution for both routine and non-routine alpha spectroscopy applications.
FastScan™ High-Throughput Whole Body Counter

The FastScan High-Throughput Whole Body Counter ensures rapid and accurate internal contamination screening, processing 30 to 50 people per hour with high accuracy and minimal maintenance. Its advanced design and user-friendly features make it an essential tool for nuclear environments.

raw_blocks: At Mirion, we partner with our customers to build solutions that fundamentally change what's possible in science, industry, and medicine.
Safety is at the core of our solutions
We enable safer production of nuclear power, supporting global energy production and carbon neutrality
Provide a safer working environment for medical professionals
Assist patients to obtain the life-saving treatments they need
Help protect our heroes on the front-lines
Mirion provides an unmatched range of proven technologies and unrivaled expertise in radiation safety & science.
We partner with our customers to solve essential radiation safety challenges today — and empower their innovations to better the human condition tomorrow.

From securing borders and providing clean energy, to fueling space exploration and treating cancer, there is essential and inspiring work being done by the customers we serve. At Mirion, we take great pride in these partnerships.
At Mirion Technologies, we partner with industry leaders to advance radiation safety and empower the next wave of critical innovation.
At Mirion Medical, we drive The Science of Better. From diagnosis through treatment, we partner with medical professionals to enhance the delivery and ensure the safety of healthcare.
Our Mission is to harness our unrivaled knowledge of ionizing radiation for the greater good of humanity.
Beginnings in Radiation Science & Safety Technology

Mirion was formed between 1950 and 2004 through the joining together of innovators and manufacturers in radiation solutions and services for industrial markets. In December 2005, Mirion was incorporated and organized into divisions to support vital markets, including Radiation Monitoring, Health Physics, Sensing, Imaging and Dosimetry Services.

Our investment in healthcare began in late 2003 with the Dosimetry Services division. Since growing our capabilities in occupational dosimetry, medical imaging, nuclear medicine, radiation therapy and diagnostic imaging QA, we announced the official formation and branding of the Mirion Medical group in July 2022.

Today, we are proud to be a leading provider of detection, measurement, analysis and monitoring solutions to the nuclear, defense, medical and research end markets. We owe our longevity and achievements to our customers who have worked with us over the years to break boundaries of what is considered possible in their industries.
Chairman of the Board, Chief Executive Officer and Founder

Thomas Logan is the Founder of Mirion, and has served as its Chief Executive Officer since 2005, where he is responsible for all aspects of the company's operations. He has served as a member of Mirion’s Board of Directors since 2005 and as the Chair of the Board since February 2025. Previously, Mr. Logan served as CEO for Global Dosimetry Solutions. Mr. Logan has more than 30 years of energy industry experience. In addition, he has extensive experience within the contract manufacturing and consumer products industries. Mr. Logan holds a Bachelor of Science degree and a Master in Business Administration from Cornell University.
Chief Legal Officer & Chief Compliance Officer

Emmanuelle Lee has served as Deputy General Counsel of Mirion Technologies since 2011 and General Counsel and Chief Compliance Officer since 2018. Ms. Lee’s prior positions include corporate counsel positions with FrontRange Solutions (now Ivanti) and PeopleSoft (now Oracle), and attorney at the law firm of Ropers Majeski, Kohn & Bentley. In addition, she started her career as a parliamentary aid to the late Xavier de Villepin, a French Senator who represented French expatriates and headed the Senate Committee for Foreign Affairs, Defense, and Armed Forces. Ms. Lee received her Juris Doctor from Santa Clara University, California and her French law degree from Université de Paris II Panthéon-Assas.
​Chief Financial Officer & Medical Group President

Brian Schopfer has served as the Chief Financial Officer of Mirion since 2020 and assumed the additional role of Medical Group President in 2025. Mr. Schopfer joined Mirion in 2015 and previously served as Mirion’s Executive and Senior Vice President of Business Transformation. In February 2018, Mr. Schopfer left Mirion and joined Omnimax International, a building products company, where he served as Chief Financial Officer of North America until March 2019. Mr. Schopfer rejoined Mirion in March 2019. Prior to joining Mirion, Mr. Schopfer served as Chief Financial Officer for Hillphoenix (part of the Dover Corporation), a commercial refrigeration manufacturer, from 2014 to 2015. Mr. Schopfer also served as the Director of Financial Planning and Analysis for the Dover Corporation, a global manufacturing company, from 2013 to 2014. Mr. Schopfer received a B.S. in Finance and Marketing from the University of Pittsburgh.

Loic Eloy has served as our Technologies Group President since 2022. Mr. Eloy joined Mirion in 2015 and previously served as Vice President of Mirion’s Detection and Measurement (Health Physics) Division from 2015 to 2019 and President of Mirion’s Radiation Monitoring Systems Division from 2019 to 2022. Prior to joining Mirion, Mr. Eloy served as Director of Finance and Accounting of Areva from February 2008 to February 2012, and then Commercial Director from February 2012 to January 2015. Prior to 2008, Mr. Eloy held various finance and commercial positions with Siemens. Mr. Eloy received an MBA from the Universidad Panamericana and a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Administration, Economics and Marketing from the University of Lyon.

Alison Ulrich was named Chief Human Resources Officer in April 2022. Prior to becoming CHRO, Alison served as the Global HR Director for Mirion and was responsible for managing and building the HR function to support our growing employee base, leading our global HR initiatives and policies, and implementing programs to elevate the employee experience across the board. Alison has been with Mirion since 2004.

James Cocks was named Chief Technology Officer in October 2023. Previously, he assumed the role of Chief Product Officer since July 2022. Prior to this role, James served as North America Detection & Measurement Division President for three years and, for three years prior to that, Characterization Division President. James also served as Chief Technology Officer for Canberra Industries before its acquisition by Mirion in 2016. During his 18 years with the company, he held management positions in Product Management, Engineering and Business Development. He began his career as a Research Physicist working at the Accelerator Laboratory at University of Jyväskylä, Finland. He holds a PhD in Nuclear Physics from Liverpool, UK and an MBA from Henley Business School, UK.
Chief Marketing Officer & SVP, Government Affairs

Erin has served as Chief Marketing Officer for Mirion since 2023, leading global brand strategy, marketing innovation, and cross-divisional alignment to reinforce Mirion’s leadership across diverse end-markets. In addition to marketing leadership, Erin also oversees Government and Industry Affairs as Senior Vice President, where she applies strategic insight to foster engagement with public sector stakeholders, regulators, and industry partners—advancing Mirion’s impact within nuclear energy, defense, medical and safety-critical fields. Erin has over 20 years of experience in the radiation therapy industry having held various marketing leadership roles with Elekta and ViewRay. Erin earned a Bachelor of Arts degree in Communication from Randolph-Macon Women’s College.

Christopher Moore has served as Mirion’s Chief Accounting Officer since March 28, 2022. Prior to joining Mirion, Mr. Moore served as Global Controller of Lime Transportation, a non-public technology company, from October 2021 to March 2022. Mr. Moore also served as Global Corporate Controller of Carestream Dental, a non-public healthcare company, from October 2019 to October 2021. Mr. Moore previously served as Global Business Controller - Renewable Energy of General Electric, a public industrials company, from June 2017 to October 2019. Mr. Moore received a Bachelor of Business Administration from the University of Michigan.
Chief Artificial Intelligence & Digital Officer

Shahmeer Mirza joined Mirion in October 2025 and serves as Chief Artificial Intelligence and Digital Officer. He is responsible for leading the continuation of Mirion’s digital transformation roadmap leveraging technologies like AI to innovate, improve processes, and create new revenue streams. Prior to his role with Mirion, Shahmeer served as Senior Director of Data, AI/Machine Learning, and Research and Development at 7-Eleven. Shahmeer holds a Master of Science in Computer Science and a Bachelor of Science in Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering from the Georgia Institute of Technology.

Tighe Smith serves as Chief Nuclear Officer at Mirion, bringing over 20 years of experience across nuclear engineering, digital safety systems, commercial leadership, and industry policy engagement. In this role, he guides Mirion’s nuclear strategy across the global operating fleet and emerging advanced reactor markets. Tighe previously held the CNO role at Paragon Energy Solutions, now part of Mirion, where he supported strategic growth initiatives, captured key SMR customers, and drove the expansion of digital safety and instrumentation capabilities. He is an active contributor to the broader nuclear community, serving as a Trustee of the American Nuclear Society and as Convenor of IEC SC45A Working Group 9, helping advance international standards for nuclear instrumentation and control. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Nuclear Engineering and an MBA from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville.

Marc Rubel joined Mirion in October 2025 and serves as Chief Information Officer. He leads the company’s technology strategy and oversees the delivery of secure, reliable, and scalable information systems that support business objectives. Marc partners with executive leadership and business units to align technology investments with strategic priorities, improve operational efficiency, and enable growth. Prior to joining Mirion, Marc served as Chief Information Officer at Molycop and Yarde Metals and held multiple senior IT leadership roles at General Electric. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology from the University of Hartford.

On Clarity and Culture: Insights from CEO Thomas Logan

In an episode of The Smart Money Circle podcast, Mirion’s CEO, Thomas Logan, sat down with host Adam Sarhan to discuss his personal journey, leadership philosophy and the remarkable story of Mirion. With a focus on clarity and risk management, Logan provides insights into the company's success and the investment opportunities it presents.
